review.plausibility: Leyla is a popular Persian-origin name in Azerbaijan for women born 2000–2003. Aliyev is a common patronymic surname; Aliyeva marks female.

review.plausibility: Rasul is popular for Azerbaijani men born 1996–1999. Hasanov follows -ov patronymic suffix (from Hasan). Born c.1997, fits young professional cohort.
